name: Mithka 1.9.5 · 20261101
body:
Clearer voice-message controls, more icon choices on iPhone, and updated translations.

On iPhone, recordings now wait in the message bar as drafts. Play them back, trim either end or remove them before sending. Use the normal Send button, with any text you enter included as the caption. Hold Send for delivery options; the send action stays visible while longer lists of options scroll.

On iPhone, a different penguin from the 48-icon collection is free to choose each day, alongside nine standard icons. Your selected icon stays until you change it. Standard icons now show their matching backgrounds in the picker.

Headers align more consistently on the opened iPhone Duo. Icon names and Supporter explanations have updated translations in German, Spanish, French, Japanese and Korean.

优化语音消息操作，丰富 iPhone 图标选择，并完善多语言文案。

在 iPhone 上，录音现在会作为草稿保留在消息输入框上方。发送前可试听、修剪两端或移除录音。使用常规发送按钮即可发送，输入的文字会作为语音说明一同发送。长按发送按钮可选择发送方式；选项较多时，发送按钮仍固定显示，其余选项可滚动查看。

在 iPhone 上，每天都可从 48 款企鹅图标中免费选择当天的一款，另外还有 9 款标准图标可随时使用。已选图标会一直保留，直到您主动更换。标准图标现在会在选择页面中显示对应的背景。

优化展开状态下 iPhone Duo 的标题栏对齐，并完善德语、西班牙语、法语、日语和韩语的图标名称及 Supporter 说明。

name: v1.8.2 Nightly 2026-10-22 (27a657a)
body:
## Changes
### English
- The group and channel context-pane toggle now applies across all chats, and the default-closed setting has been removed.
- Long-press a mobile folder tab or secondary-click a desktop tab to edit, add chats, mark all as read, or reorder folders.
- A new composer format panel lets you apply text formatting to a selected range.
- Playback taps that drift no longer trigger accidental seeks, and deliberate queue swipes still work as expected.
- Comments on channel posts with no replies now load correctly, so you can open the thread and comment.
- Composer-docked panels and the pinned-message bar now blend with the composer, and the attachment strip adds a camera entry with updated video-message controls.

### 中文
- 群组和频道的上下文面板开关现在会应用于所有聊天，并已移除默认关闭面板的设置。
- 在手机上长按文件夹标签，或在桌面端右键点击标签，即可编辑、添加聊天、将所有消息标为已读或重新排序文件夹。
- 新增的输入栏格式面板可为选中的文本范围应用格式。
- 播放时轻微滑动的点击不再导致意外跳转，主动滑动仍可切换播放队列。
- 尚无回复的频道帖子现在也能正确加载评论，方便你打开讨论串并发表评论。
- 输入栏停靠面板和置顶消息栏现在与输入栏融为一体；附件栏新增相机入口，视频消息控制按钮也经过调整。


**Full changelog:** [v1.8.1-nightly.20261019.b7c98d5...v1.8.2-nightly.20261022.27a657a](https://github.com/iebb/mithka/compare/v1.8.1-nightly.20261019.b7c98d5...v1.8.2-nightly.20261022.27a657a)

name: v1.8.1 Nightly 2026-10-19 (b7c98d5)
body:
## Changes
### English
- Music playback now automatically recovers from missing cached files or failed downloads, and reports tracks that still cannot play only once.
- You can choose your custom emoji when picking a topic icon.
- Installed emoji packs now stay associated with the correct account when you switch accounts.
- Message search works with a selected sender even when the search field has no words, and reply actions appear only where replies are allowed.
- Profile bios can open the mentioned person’s profile, and animated featured photos play in the viewer.
- Bottom-bar spacing now better respects system navigation, and iPad display zoom no longer creates extra empty space above headers.

### 中文
- 音乐播放现在会自动从缓存文件丢失或下载失败中恢复；对于仍无法播放的曲目，只提示一次。
- 选择话题图标时，现在可以使用你自己的自定义表情。
- 切换账号时，已安装的表情包现在会保留在对应的账号中。
- 选择发送者后，即使搜索框中没有文字，也可以搜索消息；只有允许回复的消息才会显示回复操作。
- 现在可以从个人简介中打开被提及者的个人资料，特色动态照片也会在查看器中播放。
- 底部栏间距现在能更好地适配系统导航；iPad 显示缩放也不会再导致标题上方出现多余空白。


**Full changelog:** [v1.7.10-nightly.20261018.8d4dfd1...v1.8.1-nightly.20261019.b7c98d5](https://github.com/iebb/mithka/compare/v1.7.10-nightly.20261018.8d4dfd1...v1.8.1-nightly.20261019.b7c98d5)

name: Mithka 1.7.11 · 20261018
body:
## English

Mithka 1.7.11 improves forum-topic navigation, adaptive phone and tablet layouts, sender-filtered search, profile links, and notification exceptions. Music and voice playback handle account changes and interruptions more reliably. This release also refines contact search, proxy status, message replies, rich-text editing, localization, and overall stability.

## 中文

Mithka 1.7.11 优化论坛话题导航、手机与平板自适应布局、按发送者搜索、个人资料链接和通知例外设置。音乐与语音播放在切换账号及播放中断时更加可靠，并改进联系人搜索、代理状态、消息回复、富文本编辑、多语言和整体稳定性。

**Full changelog:** [v1.6.10...v1.7.11](https://github.com/iebb/mithka/compare/v1.6.10...v1.7.11)

name: v1.7.10 Nightly 2026-10-18 (8d4dfd1)
body:
## Changes
### English
- Search for users by ID across app search and contacts, and jump to messages from a chosen date in chat search.
- Self-built versions with the explicit opt-in can use Ghost Mode and keep a local history of deleted or edited messages; both features are unavailable unless enabled at build time.
- Choose to automatically reveal restricted content already available on your device, while sender-added media spoilers remain covered.
- Opt in to richer link previews for supported sites using metadata mirrors, without changing the link in your message.
- Import and export GramJS string sessions in account backups.
- Use bot inline features including message attribution, switch-inline buttons, and an inline query panel.

### 中文
- 可在应用搜索和联系人中按用户 ID 搜索，并在聊天搜索中跳转到指定日期的消息。
- 通过明确的构建时选项启用后，自行构建的版本可使用幽灵模式，并在本地保留已删除或编辑消息的历史；未启用时这些功能不可用。
- 可选择自动显示设备上已获取的受限内容，同时发送者添加的媒体剧透仍会保持遮挡。
- 可选择通过元数据镜像为支持的网站获取更丰富的链接预览，且消息中的链接保持不变。
- 账户备份现支持导入和导出 GramJS 字符串会话。
- 现支持机器人内联功能，包括消息署名、切换内联按钮和内联查询面板。


**Full changelog:** [v1.7.9-nightly.20261017.e8bb98a...v1.7.10-nightly.20261018.8d4dfd1](https://github.com/iebb/mithka/compare/v1.7.9-nightly.20261017.e8bb98a...v1.7.10-nightly.20261018.8d4dfd1)

body:
## Changes
### English
- Keep the keyboard open while sending messages from the composer.
- Search filter hints are tappable, sender filters stay selected, and has: filters can be combined with other filters.
- Message formatting now stays aligned after extra whitespace is trimmed from posts, captions, and comments.

### 中文

name: v1.7.5 Nightly 2026-10-13 (0b397ce)
body:
## Changes
### English
- Community owners and authorized admins can update a community’s name and photo from its hub.
- The composer now combines emoji, stickers, and GIFs in one media picker, with emoji recents, category navigation, and long-press previews.
- Optional chat settings add spaces between Chinese, Japanese, or Korean characters and half-width Latin letters or digits, while preserving message content and links.
- Forum topics are easier to browse and manage with message previews, live updates, topic actions, and topic-labeled sections in the all-topics view.
- Sticker management adds drag-and-drop reordering, batch deletion, set links, and more editing options.
- Login and proxy screens behave more reliably during account changes, and profile usernames and t.me links respond to taps with a browser fallback when chat lookup fails.

### 中文
- 社区创建者和拥有相应权限的管理员现在可以在社区主页修改社区名称和照片。
- 输入栏现将表情、贴纸和 GIF 合并到同一个媒体面板，并提供最近使用的表情、分类导航和长按预览。
- 聊天设置新增可选项，可在中文、日文或韩文字符与半角拉丁字母或数字之间添加空格，同时保留消息内容和链接。
- 论坛主题更易浏览和管理，现支持消息预览、实时更新、主题操作，以及在全部主题视图中按主题标记消息。
- 贴纸管理新增拖放排序、批量删除、贴纸集链接和更多编辑选项。
- 切换账号时，登录和代理页面的表现更加可靠；个人资料中的用户名和 t.me 链接现在可点击，无法查找聊天时会提供浏览器打开选项。


**Full changelog:** [v1.7.4-nightly.20261012.051e106...v1.7.5-nightly.20261013.0b397ce](https://github.com/iebb/mithka/compare/v1.7.4-nightly.20261012.051e106...v1.7.5-nightly.20261013.0b397ce)

name: v1.7.4 Nightly 2026-10-12 (051e106)
body:
## Changes
### English
- Music playlists now load reliably after startup, including libraries split across playlist folders; loading no longer appears as an empty library.
- Looping WebM video stickers on iOS now play at the correct speed while retaining transparency.
- Contacts, mini-app discovery, and installed custom emoji packs load faster by fetching related data concurrently.
- Media and call durations of an hour or more now display in hour-based format instead of minutes exceeding 59.

### 中文
- 音乐播放列表现在能在应用启动后可靠加载，包括分散在多个播放列表文件夹中的内容；加载时也不再误显示为空列表。
- iOS 上循环播放的 WebM 视频贴纸现在速度正确，同时保留透明效果。
- 通过并发获取相关数据，联系人、小程序发现和已安装的自定义表情包加载更快。
- 时长达到一小时或更久的媒体和通话现在以小时格式显示，不再出现超过 59 分钟的计时。


**Full changelog:** [v1.7.3-nightly.20261011.202b98d...v1.7.4-nightly.20261012.051e106](https://github.com/iebb/mithka/compare/v1.7.3-nightly.20261011.202b98d...v1.7.4-nightly.20261012.051e106)

name: v1.7.3 Nightly 2026-10-11 (202b98d)
body:
## Changes
### English
- View photos and videos’ available details—including file type, name, dimensions, duration, size, and, when available, frame rate, bitrate, codec, and MIME type—in the new Media info menu. You can turn this option off in Chat Behavior settings.
- The selected tab highlight now fits around its icon and label, including on narrow tablets and at larger text sizes.
- The app’s launch screen now follows your system’s light or dark appearance, avoiding a bright flash in dark mode.
- Save featured photos from your own profile using the actions sheet.
- Video stickers now keep looping instead of freezing after one play.
- Community catalogs now work with both supported response formats, keeping linked chats available.

### 中文
- 现在可以在新增的“媒体信息”菜单中查看照片和视频的可用详情，包括文件类型、名称、尺寸、时长、大小，以及在有信息时显示的帧率、比特率、编解码器和 MIME 类型。可在“聊天行为”设置中关闭此选项。
- 选中标签的高亮现在能完整贴合图标和文字，在窄屏平板和较大字号下也能正确显示。
- 应用启动画面现在会跟随系统的浅色或深色外观，避免深色模式下出现短暂的亮白画面。
- 现在可以通过个人资料中的操作菜单保存精选照片。
- 视频贴纸现在会持续循环播放，不再播放一次后停在最后一帧。
- 社区目录现在兼容两种受支持的响应格式，确保关联聊天仍可显示。


**Full changelog:** [v1.7.2-nightly.20261010.3829158...v1.7.3-nightly.20261011.202b98d](https://github.com/iebb/mithka/compare/v1.7.2-nightly.20261010.3829158...v1.7.3-nightly.20261011.202b98d)

name: v1.7.2 Nightly 2026-10-10 (3829158)
body:
## Changes
### English
- Video player chrome now appears immediately while media is still loading, keeping controls accessible before playback starts.
- Chat navigation and list updates are smoother: returning chat lists rebuild once, exiting transcripts stop syncing mid-transition, and chat list resorting avoids unnecessary full re-sorts during non-order updates.
- Tablet topic navigation now overlays the topic list over the chat column, and swipe-to-reply works across the full row with a larger touch target.
- The login experience and account tools were refreshed with a cleaner layout, a live proxy shortcut in the sidebar, and clearer handling of login states and connection details.
- Profile and community views gained useful details: you can see an estimated account registration month, copy profile fields with a long press, communities offer a direct hub entry, and member role tags are less visually dominant.

### 中文
- 视频播放器在媒体仍在加载时即显示播放器界面，并在播放开始前保持控件可访问。
- 聊天导航和列表更新更顺畅：返回的聊天列表只重建一次，退出中的会话不会在过渡中继续同步，且聊天列表在非排序更新时避免不必要的整列表重排。
- 平板电脑的主题导航现在会将主题列表覆盖在聊天栏上，并且“滑动回复”覆盖整行操作，触控目标更大。
- 登录体验和账号工具已更新：登录界面更简洁，侧边栏新增可实时显示状态的代理快捷入口，并改善了登录状态与连接信息的处理。
- 个人资料和社区视图新增实用信息：可查看账号的大致注册月份，长按可复制资料字段，社区可直接进入中心，成员角色标签的视觉强调也更柔和。

name: v1.7.1 Nightly 2026-10-09 (acf515c)
body:
## Changes
### English
- Hide a group member’s messages on this device, in one group, or across all chats without blocking or notifying them. Manage hidden members in Settings and restore their messages anytime.
- The sticker and emoji finder scans chat history in the background, with pause and resume controls. See usage and distinct-sender counts, and reopen the finder with saved results and scanning progress preserved.
- Show forum topics as regular chats with topic-specific transcripts; messages, attachments, forwards, and inline bot results go to the open topic.
- The music player adds seeking, previous-track controls, shuffle, and improved queue navigation. Use system media controls, and enjoy more reliable playback—including continued Android playback in the background.
- Group and channel management now offers searchable, paginated member lists, member restrictions, permanent deletion options, and a way for group owners to upgrade basic groups. Management pages also show information as it loads.
- The full-screen image viewer now offers actions to copy or save images, view them in chat, and reply to their messages.￼

### 中文
- 可在本设备、单个群组或所有聊天中隐藏某位群成员的消息，而不会屏蔽或通知对方。可在设置中管理隐藏成员，并随时恢复其消息。
- 贴纸和表情查找器可在后台扫描聊天记录，并支持暂停和继续。查看使用次数和不同发送者人数；重新打开时，已保存的结果和扫描进度都会保留。
- 可将论坛话题显示为普通聊天，并查看各话题独立的聊天记录；消息、附件、转发内容和内联机器人的结果都会发送到当前话题。
- 音乐播放器新增进度拖动、上一首、随机播放和更便捷的队列浏览。可使用系统媒体控制，并享受更可靠的播放体验，包括在 Android 后台持续播放。
- 群组和频道管理现支持搜索及分页浏览成员、限制成员权限、永久删除选项，以及由群主将基础群组升级为超级群组。管理页面还会在信息加载过程中逐步显示内容。
- 全屏图片查看器现可复制或保存图片、在聊天中查看图片，以及回复对应消息。￼

name: Mithka 1.6.10 · 20261009
body:
## Changes

### English
Mithka 1.6.10 improves group and forum-topic navigation, member search and moderation, and folder unread badges. A new preference keeps the group side panel closed until needed. Gallery actions make copying, saving, and returning to the source chat easier. Music and voice playback recover more reliably, and the queue follows the playing track after reordering. Reply handling, rich-text forwarding, media opening, localization, and desktop interactions are also improved.

### 中文
1.6.10 优化群组与论坛话题导航、成员搜索和管理，以及聊天分组未读徽标。新增群组侧栏默认收起选项，图库支持复制、保存和返回原聊天。改进音乐与语音播放恢复，播放列表在重新排序后保持定位到当前曲目，并提升回复、富文本转发、媒体打开、多语言和桌面交互体验。

body:
## Changes
### English
- Video playback is now scoped to the source account, so videos in chats and moments stay tied to the right account and context.
- Desktop keyboard shortcuts are now kept local to Mithka and preserved across search and input surfaces while keeping platform shortcuts available.
- The desktop title bar now shows status and includes profile editing controls for quicker account access.

### 中文
- 视频播放现在会绑定到来源账号，确保聊天和动态中的视频始终与对应账号和上下文保持一致。
- 桌面端键盘快捷键现在仅限于 Mithka，并在搜索和输入区域中保持可用，同时保留平台快捷键。
- 桌面端标题栏现在显示状态，并提供个人资料编辑控件，方便快速访问账号信息。

name: v1.5.4 Nightly 2026-09-23 (425fe98)
body:
## Changes
### English
- Video playback is more stable after seeking, avoiding stalled playback when interrupted ranges are abandoned.
- Video playback failures are reported more clearly, and Android video plugin registration has been restored for better reliability.
- Message links are now separated from bubble text so links and text formatting are clearer.
- File and video downloads can now be managed across chats, and downloaded content can be kept outside the app cache.
- Provider settings now clearly show the full API endpoint URL format.

### 中文
- 视频播放在跳转后更稳定，避免放弃中断片段时出现播放卡住。
- 视频播放失败会更清晰地上报，并恢复 Android 视频插件注册，提升可靠性。
- 消息链接现在与气泡文字分开处理，因此链接和文本格式更清晰。
- 文件和视频下载现在可以跨聊天管理，并且下载内容可保留在应用缓存之外。
- 提供商设置现在会清晰显示完整的 API 端点 URL 格式。
